spanish: y pieles de carneros enrojecidas y pieles de tahash y maderas de shitím,

findings.issue: The pual passive participle is masculine plural and can agree with the skins or the rams. enrojecidas binds the reddening only to pieles.
תְּחָשִׁים is a common noun (masculine plural absolute), not a proper name. tahash leaves the lemma untranslated and changes the plural to a singular label.
שִׁטִּים is a common noun (feminine plural absolute, acacia), not a proper name. shitím leaves the lemma untranslated.

notes: y pieles de carneros and y maderas de match the two construct chains and their conjunctions.
